titles.title: ACCESS Rural America Act
ACCESS Rural America Act
Access to Capital Creates Economic Strength and Supports Rural America Act
A bill to amend the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to address registration exemptions for securities of issuers that are rural telephone companies, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

committee.name: Senate Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs
